newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's anti-drug chief to visit Britain.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's anti-drug chief to visit Britain.

text.p: Colombia's top anti-drug agent Col. Leonardo Gallego will travel to London on Sunday for a week of meetings with his British counterparts, officals said.
Gallego's trip is the latest in a series of high-level contacts between Colombia and Britain on counter-narcotics cooperation.

During his week-long visit, Gallego, director of the counter-narcotics division of the National Police, will meet Derek Pumbly, a leading British anti-drug official who came to Colombia on a fact-finding mission in early October.
He will also hold talks with customs officials and share information on trafficking methods and transport routes, a police spokesman said.

The spokesman was unable to give exact figures on clandestine shipments of Colombian cocaine and heroin to Britain and other parts of Europe but said "significant" amounts were being trafficked given the size of seizures reported by customs officials.
